technology_name: A DARK-CURRENT FREE AND CHARGE CARRIER-DIFFUSION BASED SELF-POWERED PHOTODETECTOR AND METHOD OF OPERATING THE SAME
institution: National Institute of Technology Calicut (NIT Calicut)
problem_solved: Standard photodetectors suffer from high dark-current noise floors and require continuous external battery power, restricting their use in remote or ultra-low-noise environments.
description: A novel self-powered photodetector architecture operating via charge-carrier diffusion phenomena across a cellulose paper substrate layer layered with low-resistance/high-resistance channels, rendering it entirely dark-current free.
applications: Zero-bias optical communication nodes, ultra-low-noise scientific imaging sensors, remote environmental light logging, and secure military fiber links.
